# Lansing — Capital Infrastructure Record

> The operating system underneath Michigan politics runs from 201 Townsend Street.

## About

Lansing documents the capital infrastructure layer of Michigan politics — centered on Dykema Gossett PLLC, the state's largest law firm. Part of the [primals.eco evidence network](https://sporeprint.primals.eco).

No third-party analytics. No cookies. No tracking pixels. Log-based observation only.

## Sections

- [Actors](https://lansing.primals.eco/actors/) — Key actors in the Lansing capital infrastructure
- [Analysis](https://lansing.primals.eco/analysis/) — Infrastructure analysis and pattern documentation
- [Evidence](https://lansing.primals.eco/evidence/) — Primary source evidence library
- [Timeline](https://lansing.primals.eco/timeline/) — Chronology 1988–present

## Actors

- [Tom Barrett — U.S. House MI-7](https://lansing.primals.eco/actors/tom-barrett/): Dykema Federal PAC $4,000. AFP Action $477,780 (44.8%). Called opponent "convicted felon" over expunged conviction.
- [Dykema Gossett — Michigan's Operating System](https://lansing.primals.eco/actors/dykema-gossett/): MI's largest law firm. 201 Townsend, Lansing. Drafted PA 362. Five-level stack. 7+ dark money vehicles. Federal PAC $131K to 47 candidates both parties. State PAC $725K+.
- [Judge Patricia Tremblay — 30th Circuit Court](https://lansing.primals.eco/actors/judge-tremblay/): Ingham County. Recused from Banks PPO. 18yr overlap with Lansing campaign finance. Former House Dem Caucus Legal Counsel.
- [W. Alan Wilk — Dark Money Architect](https://lansing.primals.eco/actors/w-alan-wilk/): Dykema Member, Team Leader Political Compliance. Incorporator of 7+ dark money vehicles. wawilk@dykema.com.
- [Renae Moore — 80 Accounts Under Oath](https://lansing.primals.eco/actors/renae-moore/): Dykema Senior Compliance Specialist. Testified Feb 26, 2025. 80+ accounts. 6 simultaneous entity roles. rmoore@dykema.com.

## Analysis

- [The Capital Kernel](https://lansing.primals.eco/analysis/capital-kernel/): Dykema Gossett as infrastructure — the five-level stack from legislative drafting to PAC compliance. Formation-compliance kernel. Bipartisan proof. Who has root access?
